title: Family Church Students — Announcements

items.title: Wednesday Night
details: Hangout at 6:00, service about 6:30, pickup through 8:15.

items.title: Pumpkin Party / Student Costume Night
details: Church-friendly costumes welcome (or grab one from the free bin). Bring 4 friends and a carving pumpkin (at least 10 lb) for the outdoor pumpkin smash team game. Guests are welcome!

items.title: 24-Hour Prayer
details: Overnight: high school and up, with a leader.
Sign-up coming / details still being finalized.

items.title: Friendsgiving
details: Students bring desserts. Guests don't need to bring food. Short message, then high school open gym after middle school pickup.

items.title: Christmas Party
details: Big invite night. All students (middle and high school) combined. Details still being finalized.

items.text: Be considerate if pizza dinner is offered.
Costume guidelines for Pumpkin Party: church-friendly and modest, no full-face masks during the program, no weapons, nothing gory or offensive. Closed-toe shoes for the smash.
